elements.label: Hover tooltip card for the 'Authentication options' bubble

pattern.description: The cursor rests on a bubble in the Impact vs. Effort chart and a white tooltip card (idea title plus Impact and Effort dot ratings) fades in above it as a single unit, timed to the narration 'quick wins'.
pattern.why_premium: The hover is timed to the spoken phrase, so the data behind one bubble shows up just as the narrator names it. The tooltip appears in a quick opacity fade with no layout jump, so the eye stays on the chart.

build_hint.gsap: gsap.fromTo('.tooltip', {autoAlpha: 0}, {autoAlpha: 1, duration: 0.15, ease: 'power2.out'}) triggered when the cursor reaches the bubble; title and both rating rows ride with the card (no stagger).
build_hint.remotion: opacity = interpolate(frame - hoverFrame, [0, 4], [0, 1], {easing: Easing.out(Easing.quad), extrapolateLeft: 'clamp', extrapolateRight: 'clamp'}) on the tooltip container; children inherit.

notes: Screen recording of a native UI hover. The filmstrip crops are zoomed, and the bubble under the cursor may also change its colour or ring state (grey with a ring at the start, purple at the end), but there is no candidate box for it and the crop makes it unclear, so it is not listed. Text boxes b02-b04 fade with the card and are not listed separately.
